project_comments.note: Architectural debt: IDListParameter and StringListParameter both contain a private requireValidType() method with near-identical logic (null→[], array passthrough, string→explodeTrim, throw otherwise). If a third list-type parameter is added, this pattern should be extracted to a protected method in BaseAPIParameter or a shared trait (e.g., ListParameterTrait) to eliminate the duplication. Also, IDListParameter::selectValue() returns BaseAPIParameter rather than self — this should be narrowed to self to match StringListParameter's superior pattern and preserve fluent interface typing.

project_comments.note: Cross-cutting observation: The WP-006 bug fix (AppCountryIDsHandler/AppCountryISOsHandler returning null instead of array() when getValue()===null) was discovered only during test authoring — not during implementation or earlier QA/review pipelines. This reveals a gap in the framework's contract documentation: BaseParamsHandlerContainer's 'first non-null wins' semantics are not enforced at the type level and are easy to violate silently. The fix was applied and documented in Params/README.md, but a PHPStan assertion or base-class warning on BaseParamHandler::resolveValueFromSubject() would make this contract impossible to miss for future implementors.
